title: Jagged Crumbly Turkish Millet Manti
description: A pungent and crumbly Turkish dish featuring millet, wood-fired-baked to perfection in a cazuela, perfect for meal prep and dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the millet, onion, garlic, spinach, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Spoon the mixture into small manti shapes and place them in a cazuela.
Cover the cazuela with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the manti are lightly browned.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the manti hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
